rows.Origin:
Bred by Kirin Agri Bio (Japan, 2006).
Introduced in Colombia by Alexandra Farms in 2020 as 'Princess Midori'.
rows.Bloom: Light green. None / no, mild fragrance. up to 80 petals. Small, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, rounded bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
